query: What pilot design (sample 50–100 households), pretests, and go/no‑go criteria will best validate instruments, comprehension tests, enumerator logistics, and spatial sampling?

response.query: What pilot design (sample 50–100 households), pretests, and go/no‑go criteria will best validate instruments, comprehension tests, enumerator logistics, and spatial sampling?
response.answer: A pilot design with 50-100 households will validate instruments and logistics. Pretests and a passing score will assess comprehension. Go/no-go criteria will depend on test results and enumerator feedback.
